name: Information Sharing and Analysis Centers (ISACs)
description: Member-driven organizations facilitating cyber threat intelligence sharing across 18+ critical infrastructure sectors including financial services, healthcare, energy, and transportation.

peerReview.processDescription: 18+ sector-specific ISACs. Members share IOCs and best practices. Analyst validation of shared intelligence. TLP governs classification. Cross-sector coordination through National Council of ISACs.

attribution.attributionNotes: ISAC participation demonstrates sector-specific cybersecurity commitment. No formal certifications.

povsAlignment.description: Internal audit success through sector-specific threat intelligence sharing.
